Description: Detected a Generic API Key, potentially exposing access to various services and sensitive operations.
Author: Brian McMahon
Message:
Implement Flow Doctor Phase 1: report, alert, dedup, rate limiting

Core API: init(), report(), guard(), monitor(), capture_logs()
Storage: SQLite with pluggable ABC interface, full schema (6 tables)
Notifications: Slack webhook + SMTP email with pluggable interface
Dedup: error signature hashing (SHA-256) with configurable cooldown
Rate limiting: tiered degradation, cascade-aware budget allocation
Scrubber: AWS keys, Bearer tokens, secret env vars, custom patterns
Config: YAML with env var interpolation + inline Python kwargs
Tests: 74 passing (models, config, scrubber, dedup, rate limiter, storage, reporter, notifications)
